articles.title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
articles.summary: Target-conditioned diffusion drafters predict candidate tokens in parallel, yet each new block must wait for updated target-model hidden states. This forces drafting and verification to run sequentially, limiting speedup even though each block is generated in one pass. We introduce D3D, a standalone diffusion drafter that removes this inter-round dependency. articles.summary: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive.
